We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.&nbsp;</p> <p>While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture.&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pingidentity.com/en/company/championing-every-identity.html">We champion every identity.</a> One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.&nbsp;</p> <p>We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.&nbsp;</p></div><p>As a Professional Services Engagement Manager, you will report to the Director of Professional Services and will play an essential role in Professional Services' commitment to deliver successfully on engagements striving for predictability, repeatability and financial responsibility. We are looking for someone who enjoys leading engagements for external clients and one who can manage a portfolio of complex projects. This is a hybrid role that will require 50% of your time to be spent in hands-on project management and 50% of the time to be spent in services sales. You will have several years of experience in project management best practices, consulting, and leading technology implementation projects. You will join a highly effective team with a focus towards team work, successful deployments and outstanding cooperation with our go-to-market teams. Our goal is not just to make our customers successful, but to take your project management skillset to the next level.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be the primary point of contact overseeing engagements delivered by Ping Professional Services.</li> <li>Build relationships with customers, partners, and our go-to-market teams</li> <li>Manage a portfolio of projects for successful delivery outcomes, revenue and profitability.</li> <li>Manage outcomes to resolve issues, conflicts, risks, and dependencies</li> <li>Flourish in a collaborative environment, demonstrating teamwork and excellence</li> <li>Provide written/verbal status updates to customer, partners and leadership on key project metrics</li> <li>Support revenue forecasting, invoicing and resourcing efforts for the Professional Services team</li> <li>Be an active member of project governance setup</li> <li>Support new services sales effort by attaching professional services offerings to new deals.</li> <li>Establish, monitor and manage own services sales pipeline</li> <li>Participate in regional license and services sales forecasting</li> <li>Define and present business value of services deals</li> <li>Scope complex custom services engagements together with technical consultants</li> <li>Understand and apply meaningful commercial incentives for services deals</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>You have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5 years of project management experience in consulting and technology implementation</li> <li>Motivated and comfortable adapting to change and competing demands with timelines</li> <li>Bachelor's Degree</li> <li>Exceptional skills around communications and delivery</li> <li>Can independently deliver results</li> <li>Commercial mindset</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>German, French, Spanish or Italian language skills.</li> <li>Experience with the technical implementations</li> <li>PMP Certification</li> <li>Business or technology consulting background</li> <li>Experience motivating teams</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Life at Ping:</strong></p> <p>We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.</li> <li>Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.</li> <li>Regular company and team bonding events.</li> <li>Competitive benefits and perks.</li> <li>Global volunteering and community initiatives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Benefits:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Generous PTO &amp; Holiday Schedule&nbsp;</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Progressive Healthcare Options</li> <li>Retirement Programs</li> <li>Opportunity for Education Reimbursement&nbsp;</li> <li>Commuter Offset (Specific locations)&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.</p> <p><em>We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.&nbsp; All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p></div> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-professional-services-engagement-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-professional-services-engagement-manager</a></p> Fri, 27 Nov 2026 06:03:42 +0000 Sun, 27 Dec 2026 06:03:42 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-professional-services-engagement-manager https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-profes
